description: Indonesia’s energy ministry reports national generation-capacity totals and changes for the first half of 2025. The release distinguishes overall capacity expansion from renewable additions and states targets for later years. The provider is Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, Indonesia. Coverage: Coverage is Indonesia, with a first-half-2025 snapshot compared with 2024. These are aggregate reported capacity figures, not a plant-level inventory or time-resolved operating dataset. Access: The official 13 August 2025 release was read. It reports 105 GW total capacity and a 4.4 GW increase relative to 2024; no bulk data were obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The text uses potentially confusing wording for renewable totals and additions. Detailed technology figures need checking before combining them into a balance. For simulation it supplies a dated national capacity reference and a source to check against more detailed inventories. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this dated ministry capacity statement.
